compliance.title: Product safety in the EU
compliance.p1: Safety Gate publishes alerts about dangerous non-food products. The General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) covers consumer products sold in the EU.
compliance.p2: Requirements depend on the product and country.
compliance.p3: The app provides evidence for review. It does not make legal assessments or change your products.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: The EU alert system for dangerous non-food products, formerly RAPEX. It covers products such as toys, electronics and cosmetics.
faq.a2: New alerts appear every week. After installation, we compare them with your products.
faq.q3: Does the app change my products?
faq.a3: No. It shows possible matches and evidence in Shopify Admin. You decide what to do.
faq.q4: What is included in the free scan?
faq.a4: Up to 100 public products and an emailed summary of possible matches. Private listings are excluded; the scan is not a safety certificate.

about.metaTitle: About Safety Gate Monitor – Product Safety Monitoring for Shopify
about.metaDescription: We help Shopify merchants review possible matches with dangerous products in Safety Gate.
about.title: More time for your store. More peace of mind.
about.subtitle: We want you to focus on your store. We compare your products with Safety Gate alerts about dangerous products for you.
about.missionP1: A dangerous product may have a different name or packaging in your store. Manual comparisons take time.
about.missionP2: The app finds possible matches and gathers evidence in one place in Shopify Admin.
about.missionP3: We email you immediately about new possible matches. When there are no new findings, a weekly update brings peace of mind.
about.principle1Body: We use European Commission alerts from Safety Gate.
about.principle2Body: We show possible matches and evidence. We do not automatically unpublish products.
about.principle3Body: We keep check results and your review decisions.
about.scopeBody: We are not affiliated with or endorsed by the European Commission, Safety Gate or Shopify. Possible matches support review; they are not legal assessments or legal advice.
about.ctaTitle: Focus on your store with more confidence
about.ctaSubtitle: Start with a free scan of public products.
about.contactBody: We are an independent project. Write to us about the app, a scan or your data.

footer.text: Peace of mind with ongoing Shopify product checks.
